messages:
claire: quick q — when we show the Auto-fallback control on the rollout page, do we expose an operator toggle that can be used per-customer or per-route?

ravi: we planned a per-rollout soft-toggle (5/15/60m) + a global hard override for platform admins. soft = temp suspend autoswitching, hard = persistent until manually re-enable.

sam: +1. big ask: audit trail. need who toggled, reason, and a policy snapshot attached. otherwise it's impossible to repro incidents.

claire: should the reason field be required? ops often clicks first and types later...

joel: require a short reason and an "emergency only" checkbox. store both in the audit along with the rollout snapshot and policy_hash.

ravi: followup: do we collapse multiple suspends into one audit session? eg if an operator toggles off/on repeatedly in 30m, noise explosion.

sam: retention plan we pitched: 90 days full payloads, 2 years of compact metadata. collapsing could be optional for UI view (show session grouping) but keep raw events.

claire: UI wording: I propose two affordances — "Suspend auto-fallback (soft, temporary)" vs "Disable auto-fallback (persist until re-enable)" so intent is explicit.

ravi: also show a tiny breadcrumb in the rollout timeline: "suspended by claire (5m) — view audit" so SREs see it inline.

claire: can we emit a telemetry flag autofallback.suspend_count so alerting can catch noisy usage?

joel: yes — we'll emit metric autofallback.suspends with tags {team,actor,mode,reason_len_bucket}. increments on each API call.

deploy-bot: deploy completed to eng-platform/staging at 2025-10-22T13:14:55Z :white_check_mark:

sam: API contract proposal (for platform/integration teams): POST /api/rollouts/{id}/suspend with body {mode:"soft"|"hard", duration_secs:int?, reason:string} and returns the audit_event id + policy snapshot hash.

ravi: sample request we can use in docs:
```
POST /api/rollouts/abcd/suspend
{
  "mode": "soft",
  "duration_secs": 300,
  "reason": "customer escalation - latency spike"
}
```

claire: minimal audit entry fields we want: actor, mode, duration, reason, policy_hash, timestamp, request_id, rollout_id. store full snapshot in an immutable blob keyed by policy_hash.

sam: ack. I'll draft the audit schema and UI copy. want quick thumbs?

claire: :thumbsup:

joel: :thumbsup:

ravi: merging PR for the audit schema tomorrow morning. i'll add the metric emitter too.

sam: filing follow-up doc and linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autofallback-suspend — includes operator playbook and rollback steps.

claire: thanks all — i'll add this to the rollout demo notes and mockups for next week's ux review.
